chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Billy Kyle and Lucky Millinder's band
summary: Jackson first knew Billy Kyle in Lucky Millinder's thirties band with Andy Gibson, Sweets Edison, Charlie Shavers, Kirby and Tab Smith.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: How about Billy Kyle, to get back to some piano players?

Billy Kyle to me was a fantastic piano player. I first heard him with Lucky Millinder; that's when I first knew him. He was in that great band that Lucky had back there in the thirties when he had -- Andy Gibson was in the band, Sweets Edison was in the band, Charlie Shavers.
That's right. Well, Billy Kyle was the pianist in there and John Kirby was the bass player in there, and I never paid much attention -- Oh, Tab Smith, I think, was one of the saxophones in that band.
Yeah, Tab Smith. But I never paid much attention to the rest of the band.
